units.source_text: 对局室里挂着一块半峰 [1] 的匾额，上面写着“生涯一片山水”几个字。

en.t: In the game room hung a framed plaque by Hanpo [1], inscribed with the words "A lifetime, one stretch of mountains and waters."

units.source_text: 我观赏着右下方的书法，回忆起报上刊登过有关这位高田早苗博士病笃的报道。

en.t: As I looked at the calligraphy in the lower right, I recalled a newspaper report saying that Dr. Sanae Takada was critically ill.

units.source_text: 另一块匾额是中洲三岛毅博士书写的伊东十二胜记。

en.t: Another plaque was Ito Junisho-ki, written by Dr. Nakasu Mishima Takeshi.

units.source_text: 另一间八叠的房间里，悬挂着云水僧的流浪诗的挂轴。

en.t: In another eight-mat room hung a scroll bearing a wandering poem by an unsui monk.
